name: Red Clover Case Files: Séance Soirée
source:
You're the guest of honor...and you weren't invited.

Red Clover Case Files: Séance Soirée is an indie supernatural mystery investigative visual novel. Navigate a haunted hotel, get to know a cast of bizarre psychics (and suspects), and use every trick in your notebook to identify the true killer.

Or killers.

[From [url=https://rccf.itch.io/rccf-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是贵宾…但你没有被邀请。

《红三叶草案件档案：降灵晚会》是一部独立的超自然悬疑调查视觉小说。探索闹鬼的酒店，结识一群奇异的通灵者（和嫌疑人），并使用笔记本上的每一个技巧来识别真正的凶手。

或者杀手。

[来自[url=https://rccf.itch.io/rccf-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
